# lumos_access_policy (Data Source)

An access policy: the apps and entitlements that identities matching its condition can get. Destroying it doesn't revoke access already granted through it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "lumos_access_policy" "engineering" {
  id = "<access policy id>"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The unique ID of the access policy.

### Read-Only

- `access_condition` (String) The Lumos Condition object determining which identities qualify for this policy. For more information, see the [Lumos Conditions documentation](https://docs.lumos.com/kb/life_cycle_management/building-conditions-in-lumos). Parsed as JSON.
- `apps` (Attributes Set) The apps and entitlements granted by this access policy. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--apps))
- `business_justification` (String) Explanation for why this policy exists.
- `is_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the access policy is enabled.
- `is_everyone_condition` (Boolean) True when the policy applies to everyone in your organization. `access_condition` is then null.
- `name` (String) The name of the access policy.
- `status` (String) The status of the access policy.

<a id="nestedatt--apps"></a>
### Nested Schema for `apps`

Read-Only:

- `entitlements` (Attributes Set) The entitlements granted for this app. A grant whose underlying request configuration is not yet linked to an entitlement is omitted, so this is not always the policy's complete set of grants. When more than one request configuration resolves to the same entitlement, only one entry is shown for it. Updating a policy replaces its apps wholesale, so an update built from this response drops any grant that was omitted or collapsed here. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--apps--entitlements))
- `id` (String) The ID of this app.
- `is_preapproved` (Boolean) Whether requests created via this access policy are pre-approved.

<a id="nestedatt--apps--entitlements"></a>
### Nested Schema for `apps.entitlements`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) The UUID of the entitlement.
